# Ruwais Fertiliser Plant Buildings

> Ruwais, in the Al Dhafra region of Abu Dhabi, is one of the largest industrial cities in the Gulf, home to refining, petrochemical and fertiliser plants. Within it stands an ammonia and urea fertiliser complex whose non-process buildings house offices, control and laboratory accommodation, stores, workshops and welfare facilities for a workforce running production around the clock. These buildings sit inside a live plant and are built to the safety and environmental standards such a setting demands.

## Project Overview

- Category: Infrastructure & Utilities
- Location: Ruwais, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Ruwais Fertilizer Industries (FERTIL), an ADNOC subsidiary, operates an ammonia and urea fertiliser complex at Ruwais in Abu Dhabi. This project delivered new non-process buildings and revamping works within the existing plant, with Design & Construction Engineering (DEC) and WorleyParsons as consultants. MENASCO executed the MEP works, delivering building services within the constraints of an existing industrial facility.
